label: Bargaining (Rubinstein)
text: EC.O.A3.2 Bargaining — Rubinstein: with two players, alternating offers, an infinite horizon, complete information and discount factors below one, there is a unique subgame-perfect equilibrium with immediate agreement. The theorem is MA. The choice of bargaining protocol is ST. The split is EC.
